description: This file defines an interface for supervising a WebSocket stream within the Eclipse Ditto gateway services. It extends a generic stream supervisor interface and provides a method to supervise a stream with specific identifiers and headers.

classes.name: WebSocketSupervisor
classes.description: An interface to supervise WebSocket streams, extending the generic StreamSupervisor interface, and providing the supervise method with stream, correlation ID, and headers.

methods.name: supervise
methods.description: Supervises a given SupervisedStream with the specified connection correlation ID and DittoHeaders.
